description:
## What

Two small cleanups surfaced during the audit:

1. **`extract_domain(url)` on CrestHttpClient** is a one-line passthrough to
   `@validator.extract_domain(url)`. Remove it; callers (there is exactly one,
   `perform_request`) use `@validator.extract_domain` directly.

2. **`transition_domain(from, to)`** does two things: check the target
   circuit breaker and record success on the target. The name suggests
   circuit-breaker accounting but the body is barely a transition. Either:
   - Inline it (it's called from exactly one place), or
   - Rename to `record_domain_transition` to make intent explicit.

3. **`# Same domain is always allowed`** style comments are redundant restatements
   of the method name. The good ones (subdomain, permanent, registrable domain)
   stay; the noise ones go.

## Why

- Small, but they make the file longer than it needs to be and the
  `transition_domain` name is misleading.
- Defer until after the four extractions land so the diff is reviewable in
  one place (the slimmed-down `crest_http_client.cr`).

## Done when

- `extract_domain` is gone from `CrestHttpClient`.
- `transition_domain` is either inlined or renamed.
- No comment-only noise.
title: Cleanup: remove redundant extract_domain wrapper, rename transition_domain
